tasks.title: Presenta te e un amico
tasks.prompt: Write 6 sentences in Italian about you and a friend. Use essere AND avere at least 3 times each.
frames: Il mio amico / La mia amica è…

tasks.title: Rispondi alle domande
tasks.prompt: Answer each question in a full Italian sentence.
questions: Chi è il tuo migliore amico / la tua migliore amica?

tasks.title: Due nuovi amici
tasks.prompt: Write a dialogue (at least 6 lines) between two new friends meeting for the first time. Start each line with the speaker's name.

tasks.title: Il mio tempo libero
tasks.prompt: Write 6–8 sentences about what you like to do in your free time: sports, weather, seasons. Say what you do and when.

tasks.title: Un invito
tasks.prompt: Write a text-message dialogue (at least 8 lines): one friend invites the other, the other says what they want, must, or can do. Use voglio / devo / posso + infinitive at least 4 times.

tasks.title: Domande sul tempo libero
tasks.prompt: Answer each question in a full Italian sentence.
questions: Che cosa ti piace fare nel tempo libero?
Qual è il tuo mese preferito? Perché?

tasks.title: Da piccolo/a
tasks.prompt: Write a short story (8–10 sentences) about what you used to do and how things were when you were little. Use the imperfetto. Include at least one description (era…, c'era…) and one habit (ogni giorno, sempre, di solito).

tasks.title: Intervista a un nonno o una nonna
tasks.prompt: Write an interview (at least 8 lines). A student asks a grandparent what life was like when they were young. Use the imperfetto in questions and answers.

tasks.title: Domande sull'infanzia
tasks.prompt: Answer each question in a full Italian sentence using the imperfetto.
questions: Chi era il tuo migliore amico / la tua migliore amica?

tasks.title: La mia giornata
tasks.prompt: Describe your day from waking up to going to bed (8–10 sentences). Use at least 6 reflexive verbs. Say the times.

tasks.title: Ci vediamo?
tasks.prompt: Write a dialogue (at least 8 lines) between two friends who see, call, write and meet each other. Use at least 4 reciprocal verbs with ci or si.

tasks.title: Ieri
tasks.prompt: Tell the story of yesterday (10 sentences). Use the passato prossimo of reflexive verbs. Remember: essere + the participle agrees with the subject.
frames: Io e un amico ci siamo…

tasks.title: Quando ero piccolo/a
tasks.prompt: Write about your habits as a child using reflexive verbs in the imperfetto (8 sentences). Then add one story: 'mentre mi lavavo, è suonato il telefono…'

tasks.title: Consigli e comandi
tasks.prompt: Write a dialogue (at least 8 lines) where a parent, coach or teacher gives commands to a student, and the student answers. Use at least 5 reflexive commands (tu, Lei, voi or noi).

tasks.title: Il mio futuro
tasks.prompt: What do you want to do in the future? Write 10 sentences. Use voglio + infinitive AND the future tense, with reflexive verbs where you can (mi laureerò, ci sposeremo, mi trasferirò…).

tasks.title: Una lettera informale
tasks.prompt: Write an informal email or letter (at least 120 words) to a friend in Italy. Tell about recent events (passato prossimo, imperfetto), ask three questions, and make a plan for the future.

tasks.title: Prima che…
tasks.prompt: Tell a story about a day when something unexpected happened (at least 100 words). Use the trapassato to say what had already happened before: Quando sono arrivato/a, avevo già…, ero già… Mix it with the imperfetto and the passato prossimo.
frames: Quando sono arrivato/a, i miei amici erano già…

tasks.title: Vorrei, potrei, dovresti
tasks.prompt: Write a dialogue (at least 10 lines) in a café or a shop. Make polite requests (Vorrei…, Potrei avere…?) and give advice to a friend (Al tuo posto…, Dovresti…).
